capabilities: Render vextab code blocks as tablature and notation images
Support a quicktab shorthand for jotting tab quickly
Toggle notation inclusion in quicktab via settings
extras: Known incompatibility with the Scales and Chords plugin because both use tab code blocks; only one should be enabled at a time. A future version plans an option to disable tab code blocks.
problem: Obsidian cannot render music notation or guitar tablature inside notes, and plain ASCII tab is hard to write and cannot be displayed as proper notation.

relations.evidence: Render guitar tablature and music notation using Vextab.

summary: Renders guitar tablature and standard music notation from vextab and quicktab code blocks using the VexTab language.
